units.source_text: “我活着，就绝不会让他依靠岛木或池田抚养。

en.t: As long as I am alive, I will never let him depend on Shimaki or Ikeda to raise him.

units.source_text: 啊，没想到这个家竟成了这个样子。

en.t: Ah, I never imagined this family would end up like this.

units.source_text: 想到这些，美代，真伤心啊。

en.t: When I think of all this, Miyo, it truly breaks my heart.

units.source_text: 你听着，我就是这种心思啊。”

en.t: Listen to me, this is exactly how I feel.
